name: Triclofos
summary: Triclofos (brand names Triclos, Pedicloryl) is a sedative drug used rarely for treating insomnia.

pharmacology.text: Triclofos is a prodrug which is metabolised in the liver into the active drug trichloroethanol.

uses.text: Triclofos (brand names Triclos, Pedicloryl) is a sedative drug used rarely for treating insomnia. Trichloroethanol may cause liver damage and triclofos should not be used for extended periods.

summaryZh: 三氯福司是一種有機化合物，化學式為C2H4Cl3O4P。它可由2,2,2-三氯乙醇和三氯氧磷反應製得，或通過磷酸三(2,2,2-三氯乙基)酯和磷酸反應製得。臨床上用於鎮靜、催眠和抗驚厥作用。
